A little introduction

Once an industrial area, today a waterside neighbourhood. Around Hammarby Sjö, modern homes meet quays, walking paths and green spaces — with the water at the heart of it all.

Notice the architecture

Thoughtfully connected

A greener idea
of city life.

Sustainability helped shape Hammarby Sjöstad from the planning stage. The transformation included restoring a former industrial landscape and choosing environmentally conscious building materials.

Today, its waterfront paths, green spaces and tram connections offer a different perspective on urban life.
